svg.text: Phase 5 · milestone 5 · Fuel economy: layout options
Dark theme. A stretch runs full fill to full fill; partials add in; a missed fill-up drops its stretch (a gap). Figures in each person's unit.
1 · The Fuel tab's top: the averages
Last 5 stretches, last 12 months, all time (distance ÷ fuel over the stretches that count).
2 · The chart (drawn by the app; no chart library)
Each stretch's figure in order; a dropped stretch is a gap, never a line across it.
2A · A line with a dot per stretch
Average as a hairline; only the latest labelled
Hover or tap a dot: date, figure, distance, fuel, the car's own figure.
Bars must start at a baseline; a 19 mpg floor exaggerates differences.
Highway, towing, hauling in three bands each (shares weighted by fuel); and by towed vehicle.
Hauling and towed vehicles follow the same way.
4 · Each fuel-up's line, and the ⓘ on the form
One layout: the Fuel tab's list says how each fuel-up counted; the form explains the two boxes.
counts in the next full fill-up
28 Oct · 13.1 gal · full · missed one before
not counted: an earlier fill-up wasn't logged
Filled full: the tank was filled until the pump stopped.
Economy runs from one full fill to the next; a partial
fill's fuel is added in, and it has no figure of its own.
(Opened by the ⓘ; Escape or tapping away closes it.)
One layout: the latest stretch, the last-5 average, the last fill-up.
Last fill-up 12 Nov · See all on Fuel →
Recommended: 1A, 2A, 3A (with a table view behind it), 4A, 5A.
